items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: Uh, uh, Vodery, not Vaudrey, not Bill Vaudrey.

ctx.x: This is rehearsal. So he kept bringing out, first parts, this to Herman, and I looked down left now, had Metcalf -- oh, Clarence Smith, a very good friend of mine, and a very -- one of the finest trumpet players. To me, he was second to Russell Smith, back with all those guys. He was in the First World's War One, he went to Europe with --
I'll tell you in a minute. Uh, uh, Vodery, not Vaudrey, not Bill Vaudrey.
